decision.finding: run_once reads an archive snapshot then publishes the single Anata-facing cf-anata-handoff-v1 file via unguarded atomic_write_json. Handoff exposes as_of_ms but no monotonic archive snapshot generation. A and B can share identical as_of_ms while B includes newly appended causally visible source evidence and A does not. A timestamp-only compare/guard would accept the stale A overwrite; require a publication-order or archive-generation ordering rule. Source-derived potential, not reproduced or a production incident.
runnable_no_network_contract: On authorized disposable checkout pinned to exact public SHA, add test-only part2/capital_flow/tests/test_runner_single_handoff_stale.py; use top-level spawn child worker, tmp_path, fixed T, Event/Queue barriers and bounded timeouts; no sleeps as ordering oracle.

Start child A runner.run_once(network=False,as_of_ms=T) on empty archive; monkeypatch runner.atomic_write_json in A only to capture A handoff and pause BEFORE its anata_latest.json replace; parent verifies A_ready and no A handoff publication.

Parent appends one distinct valid BTC ETF scoring FlowObservation with effective_at_ms, available_at_ms and observed_at_ms <= T; run B runner.run_once(network=False,as_of_ms=T) to completion on same local_dir. Assert A/B as_of_ms equal T; A source_evidence excludes rowB; B source_evidence clock_provenance includes source_record_id rowB; persisted file equals B anata_output.

Release A in finally; require both process exitcodes 0, final file valid JSON and still equals B output (never A), one archive row and no duplicates; sequential C positive control. A guard that compares only as_of_ms must fail this acceptance; do not require unrelated latest.json and audit_latest.json to update transactionally.
